note: packages/core/drizzle.config.ts selects tables by named globs, which drizzle-kit reads. Renaming session/sql.ts to .vibe drops its tables from the schema, and the migration check reports ungenerated migrations.
config:
import { defineConfig } from "drizzle-kit"
export default defineConfig({ dialect: "sqlite", schema: ["./src/**/*.sql.ts", "./src/**/sql.ts"], out: "./migration" })
